name: Artifact Refinement and Curation
description: Selection, edit-session history, immutable edited outputs, evidence remapping, and candidate curation.

codeEntities.label: DiagramRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists a full ASCII diagram, its evidence membership, provenance, lineage, and archive state.

codeEntities.label: DiagramComponentRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists a selected or edited ASCII component together with source selection and derivation lineage.

codeEntities.label: DiagramSelectionBounds
codeEntities.summary: Defines the inclusive line and column coordinates used to capture an ASCII selection.

codeEntities.label: cropAsciiSelection
codeEntities.summary: Normalizes selection bounds, crops occupied ASCII cells, and rejects blank or invalid selections.

codeEntities.label: createEditSession
codeEntities.summary: Starts an edit session from an immutable source artifact and copies its ASCII and evidence membership.

codeEntities.label: EditSessionRecord
codeEntities.summary: Stores base and working ASCII, ordered edit operations, cursor position, revision, and commit status.

codeEntities.label: llmEdit
codeEntities.summary: Runs an artifact-edit agent with current ASCII and markers, then records the resulting LLM patch.

codeEntities.label: EditOperationRecord
codeEntities.summary: Describes one reversible manual or LLM edit as a text patch with optional marker and agent metadata.

codeEntities.label: finishEdit
codeEntities.summary: Commits the working copy as a new edited artifact with derivation lineage and no reused spatial map.

codeEntities.label: captureComponentSelection
codeEntities.summary: Persists cropped ASCII as a selection-origin DiagramComponent with source bounds and lineage.

codeEntities.label: mapCodeEntitiesBatch
codeEntities.summary: Runs revision-scoped evidence mapping for one or more refined artifacts.

codeEntities.label: DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
codeEntities.summary: Binds an exact artifact ASCII revision to its spatial evidence mappings.

codeEntities.label: archiveDiagram
codeEntities.summary: Archives a DiagramSet-owned diagram and returns the refreshed workspace.

codeEntities.label: DiagramSetRecord
codeEntities.summary: Owns featured view references and the artifact, edit-session, generation, and agent collections for a set.

codeEntities.label: DiagramCandidateBatchRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists immutable candidate membership and the current user-supplied rank for each candidate.
